title: Keto Ethiopian Pepper Stir Fry
description: A spicy and flavorful keto stir fry made with Ethiopian spices and a variety of peppers.

ingredients.name: dabo
ingredients.notes: Rice substitute, made from cassava flour

ingredients.name: exotic pepper
ingredients.notes: Hot and spicy, use gloves when handling

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the bell pepper and exotic pepper and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the dabo, berbere spice, and a pinch of salt. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the dabo is well coated with the spice mixture.
Serve hot, garnished with additional exotic pepper slices if desired.
